verdict.rationale: Lindy's docs say it generates insights and suggestions from the user's own work data. It combines emails, meetings and calendar into answers, sends a morning or daily brief, triages the inbox, prepares draft replies, and lets teams question their recorded calls. All of this is vendor-claimed only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth documentation of insight generation over other data sources (e.g. CRM or analytics data beyond email, meetings and calendar).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Lindy combines your work context (emails, meetings, calendar) with deep web research to give you thorough, relevant answers.
Your inbox is triaged with color-coded labels, a morning brief tells you what happened overnight, and every email that needs a response has a draft waiting.
Lindy can send you a daily brief on anything you prompt it to cover.
Open a folder to your team and every call inside it becomes something anyone can question.
